race.comment: ALOHA BLUE (8) continues to leave herself with too much ground to bridge but has been hitting the line hard. Holder sticking is a big push as he should have her figured out to a tee by now. Big chance. WHOOPS A DAISY (7) had been knocking on the door before bursting through last start here when scoring by a head. Drawn much kinder than some of her main rivals which will likely give a valuable headstart when they sprint. REOFFER (6) was only headed on the line by WHOOPS A DAISY when resuming here last time. Meets the winner with a 2kg weight swing this time, so if she's come on from that she can salute. GIN RUMMY (2) returns and while he doesn't boast a great winning record he shoulders strong peaks and looks to have come back in good order winning his lead-up trial. Drawn sticky but with a touch of luck from out there he can return a winner. PRINCE KURO (3) has enough pace to offset the wide draw and can inject plenty of speed into this contest. Chance to steal it if left alone.
